}}'''Chivalry''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Knight]], a powerful mounted unit that can travel far distances, and the Destroy ability, which removes a building and its benefits at no cost.

== Spearing ==
[[Aquarion]] has the '''Spearing''' technology instead of Chivalry. Spearing unlocks the [[Tridention]], a strong ranged swimming unit with the dash and persist skills, as well as the Destroy ability. 

== Shock Tactics ==
[[Cymanti]] has the '''Shock Tactics''' technology instead of Chivalry. Shock Tactics unlocks the [[Doomux]], a powerful and agile unit with a high attack and defence. Cymanti's replacement for the Destroy ability, called Decompose, is instead unlocked by [[Construction]].
